AUTHORITY: PRIMARY OFFICIAL
SOURCE: amended_irr_bp_344_official_gazette_2.pdf | pages 50-53 | Appendix A, 6. Toilets and Baths
CANONICAL FACTS:
- On each floor level or accessible area, provide at least one (1) accessible female toilet cubicle and one (1) accessible male toilet cubicle for every 20 or fewer gendered toilet cubicles installed.
- Accessible toilet cubicles shall have a minimum area of 1800 mm x 1800 mm.
- Provide a turning space outside water closet cubicles with a minimum dimension of 1800 mm x 1800 mm.
- Water closet seat height shall be 450 mm. The water closet centerline shall be 450 mm from the finished face of the sidewall.
- Provide one fixed L-type grab bar on the side wall and one flip-up grab bar on the other side. Both grab bars shall be installed 300 mm above the toilet seat to the top of the grab bars.
- The distance from the outer face of fixed L-type grab bars to the finished face of wall shall be 100 mm. The clear distance from the face of the grab bars to the centerline of the water closet shall be 350 mm.
- Accessories and fixtures shall be installed at 1000 mm above the finished floor. Where mirrors are provided, at least one shall have its bottom edge not more than 1000 mm above the finished floor or be tilted for wheelchair use.
- Lavatories shall be mounted at 800 mm above the finished floor with vertical clear leg room not lower than 650 mm. A separate lavatory for children and shorter users may be 550 mm high and 450 mm deep.
- Toilet doors shall open outward. Doors of individual accessible toilet cubicles and stand-alone accessible toilets with lavatory shall have a horizontal pull bar at 900 mm high.
- An emergency call button shall be provided at 400 mm to 600 mm above the finished floor. Strobe light alarms are required in stand-alone accessible toilet compartments or multi-passenger toilets with accessible compartments.
- A roll-in shower compartment shall be 1800 mm x 1800 mm, with curbs not more than 12 mm high and a shower spray hose at least 1500 mm long.
USE RULES:
- Treat these values as binding for BP 344 (2024 IRR) washroom and toilet-dimension topics unless another PRIMARY OFFICIAL source in the provided context clearly supersedes them.
- Prefer the exact page-cited dimensions above over older review notes, slide decks, or pre-2024 summaries.
